meta.name: pitch-deck-visuals
meta.description: Investor pitch deck structure with slide-by-slide framework, visual design rules, and data presentation. Covers the 12-slide framework, chart types, team slides, and common investor turn-offs. Use for: fundraising decks, investor presentations, startup pitch, demo day, grant proposals. Triggers: pitch deck, investor deck, startup pitch, fundraising deck, demo day, pitch presentation, investor presentation, seed deck, series a deck, pitch slides, startup presentation, vc pitch, investor meeting

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作投资人青睐的融资路演幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在为初创公司准备融资用的路演幻灯片。
copy.tagline_en: Create investor-ready pitch deck slides for fundraising
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are preparing a pitch deck for your startup's fundraising round.

howto.what: Claude 能根据 12 页框架生成投资人演示文稿的幻灯片视觉设计，包括排版、颜色、图表类型和布局规则，并输出 HTML 或 Python 代码来渲染幻灯片。
howto.when: 当你提到“融资演示”、“投资人演示”、“创业路演”等关键词，或要求制作投资人演示文稿时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一张问题页幻灯片，突出一个关键数据。
say.note: Claude 会输出 HTML 代码，渲染后得到幻灯片。

say.text: 用 2x2 定位图展示我们的竞争格局。
say.note: Claude 会生成 Python 代码绘制竞争定位图。

say.text: 设计一张团队页，放 4 位核心成员的照片和资历。
say.note: Claude 会给出布局建议和头像生成提示。

howto.what_en: Claude generates visual designs for investor pitch deck slides based on a 12-slide framework, including typography, color, chart types, and layout rules, outputting HTML or Python code to render slides.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'pitch deck', 'investor deck', 'startup pitch', or ask to create investor presentation slides.

say_en.text: Generate a problem slide highlighting one key statistic.
say_en.note: Claude outputs HTML code to render the slide.

say_en.text: Show our competitive landscape using a 2x2 positioning map.
say_en.note: Claude generates Python code for the map.

say_en.text: Design a team slide with 4 core members' photos and credentials.
say_en.note: Claude provides layout advice and avatar generation prompts.
